Name: Godly Hands - Custom NPC Suite
Author: Aerishiph
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#E8B84A][b]✦ GODLY HAND ✦[/b][/color][/size]
[size=4][color=#7BD68C]N P C  C R E A T O R  S U I T E[/color][/size]
[size=2][color=#9AA0C0]for Stardew Valley · Content Patcher[/color][/size]

[i]Build a custom villager from start to finish,
then export it as a ready-to-use Content Patcher mod.[/i]

[color=#E8B84A]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color]

[b][color=#7BD68C]⚙ Setup[/color]  ·  [color=#7BD68C]🎬 Scenes[/color]  ·  [color=#7BD68C]🗓 Schedules[/color]  ·  [color=#7BD68C]🏃 Animations[/color]  ·  [color=#7BD68C]🎨 Sprites[/color]  ·  [color=#7BD68C]🐞 Debug[/color][/b]
[size=2][color=#9AA0C0]one file · runs in your browser · your files never leave your computer[/color][/size]

[color=#E8B84A]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color]

[size=5][color=#E8B84A][b]❀ What is this?[/b][/color][/size]

Making a custom NPC usually means juggling a dozen JSON files, digging through the wiki for event syntax, and finding out in game that [i]one missing slash[/i] broke your whole scene.

[b]Godly Hand[/b] puts all of it in one place. Set up your villager's identity, gift tastes and dialogue. Write their cutscenes, plan their day on the real map, draw and animate their sprites, then export a finished [color=#7BD68C][b][CP] [NPC] Name Core[/b][/color] folder that goes straight into [b]Mods[/b].

[quote][color=#E8B84A][b]Why I made it:[/b][/color] the existing NPC workflows frustrated me while I was making my own custom NPC. Everything here was made for real use and tested in game. Many of the warnings it gives come from bugs I hit along the way, so you won't have to.[/quote]
[color=#E8B84A]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  ✦  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color]

[size=5][color=#E8B84A][b]❀ The Tools[/b][/color][/size]
[size=2][color=#9AA0C0]Open a spoiler for the full feature list.[/color][/size]

[size=4][color=#7BD68C][b]⚙ NPC Setup[/b][/color][/size]
[i]Who they are, what they love, and the content.json that ties it all together.[/i]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Name, display name, age, manners, social anxiety, optimism, gender, home region, birthday and spawn point[/*]
[*]Datable and marriage toggles, schedule toggle and forced spawn[/*]
[*]Gift tastes with a searchable item picker, category shortcuts and direct item IDs, plus reaction dialogue for each taste level[/*]
[*]Built-in reference for dialogue tokens and portrait expressions[/*]
[*]Generates a complete [b]content.json[/b] that loads your sprites, portraits, dialogue, marriage dialogue, schedule, events, festivals, animations and ValleyTalk bio[/*]
[*][color=#7BD68C][b]Import an existing content.json[/b][/color] to keep working on it. Any links the tool doesn't generate are kept, extra fields like When and Priority included, so regenerating never drops your own work.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[size=4][color=#7BD68C][b]🎬 Scene Builder[/b][/color][/size]
[i]Write cutscenes with forms instead of raw syntax, on top of the real map.[/i]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][color=#7BD68C][b]Map renderer and coordinate picker:[/b][/color] load a .tmx or .tbin map with its tilesheets, hover for live X/Y, and click to save labelled tiles with a facing direction, sorted into folders. You can export them as a reference sheet.[/*]
[*]Saved tiles appear in every position field, so you pick a spot instead of typing numbers[/*]
[*][color=#7BD68C][b]Tile Math:[/b][/color] choose a start tile and an end tile, and the move command is worked out for you[/*]
[*]Guided forms for every common command: move, warp, speak, emote, animate, show frame, viewport, fade, sound, shake, temporary actors and sprites[/*]
[*][color=#7BD68C][b]Safe Edit mode:[/b][/color] each scene line reopens in its form, already filled in, so you can edit it without touching raw syntax. Switch to Direct Syntax whenever you want to type it yourself.[/*]
[*]Trigger conditions: heart levels, prerequisite events, time windows, days, and dating or spouse requirements[/*]
[*]One click finds a free event ID, and the tool warns you if an ID clashes with a vanilla event[/*]
[*][color=#7BD68C][b]Forks and player choices:[/b][/color] each option gets its own button label and branch scene, with optional ValleyTalk routing[/*]
[*]Map picker with notes on the vanilla locations [i](Hospital, not HarveyHouse!)[/i][/*]
[*]Music and sound pickers covering the whole soundtrack, festival tracks and character themes, with previews[/*]
[*][color=#7BD68C][b]Syntax check before you generate:[/b][/color] catches missing end commands, duplicate fork and dialogue keys, half-set viewports, slashes that would split a question, and more[/*]
[*]Events add up across a session into one file, or merge into an events file you already have[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[size=4][color=#7BD68C][b]🗓 Schedule Builder[/b][/color][/size]
[i]Plan their whole day, then watch them walk it on the map.[/i]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Build time slots by location, tile, facing direction and optional animation[/*]
[*]Every schedule key: seasons, rain, days of the week, season and day combinations, marriage variants and custom keys[/*]
[*][color=#7BD68C][b]Map preview:[/b][/color] load the map, its tilesheets and your NPC's sprite and animations, then scrub a time slider to watch where your NPC will be through the day. If they're on another map at that time, the tool tells you which one.[/*]
[*]Import an existing Schedule.json to edit it[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[size=4][color=#7BD68C][b]🏃 Animation Builder[/b][/color][/size]
[i]Click frames, preview at game speed, export Animations.json.[/i]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Load your spritesheet, click frames in play order, set speed and loop delay, and preview at game speed[/*]
[*]Name your animations to match your schedule entries exactly[/*]
[*]Generates [b]Animations.json[/b] with a syntax check and a backup of your last output, or loads an existing one to edit[/*]
[*]Spritesheet and portrait format reference with a frame layout diagram[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[size=4][color=#7BD68C][b]🎨 Sprite Maker[/b][/color][/size]
[i]Draw your villager from scratch with a layered pixel editor.[/i]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Pixel editor with layers, draw, erase, fill, lasso move, colour picker and undo/redo[/*]
[*]Saved colours and skin tone palettes[/*]
[*]Adult template, standard and oversized sheet sizes (child template in development)[/*]
[*]Put frames together into a sheet and export a PNG, ready for the Animation Builder[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[size=4][color=#7BD68C][b]🐞 Debug Commands[/b][/color][/size]
[i]Jump straight to any scene without grinding hearts.[/i]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Reads your manifest and generates the exact [i]patch reload[/i] line for your mod[/*]
[*]Imports your events into a searchable scene list (search by ID, map, hearts or day) with a ready-to-copy [i]debug ebi[/i] command for each one[/*]
[*]Other handy commands: set season, set the day of the week, patch summary and more[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[color=#E8B84A]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  ✦  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color]

[size=5][color=#E8B84A][b]❀ One Project, Every Tool[/b][/color][/size]

[b][color=#7BD68C]① LOAD[/color]  ➜  [color=#7BD68C]② BUILD[/color]  ➜  [color=#7BD68C]③ SAVE[/color]  ➜  [color=#7BD68C]④ EXPORT[/color][/b]

[list]
[*][color=#7BD68C][b]Load Project Folder[/b][/color] reads an existing mod from your computer. It finds your spritesheet, portrait, NPC name and tilesheets, and shares them with every tool. JSON files are identified by what's inside them, not their names, so it works with other people's folder layouts too.[/*]
[*][color=#7BD68C][b]Save Session[/b][/color] writes one timestamped file holding every tool's work, blank fields included. Nothing is dropped and nothing is guessed.[/*]
[*][color=#7BD68C][b]Export Mod[/b][/color] builds the finished Content Patcher folder as a ZIP. A copy of your session goes inside it, so any exported mod doubles as a backup you can load back in.[/*]
[*]You can resume from a session file, an exported ZIP, or a mod folder[/*]
[/list]
[quote][color=#E06666][b]⚠ NOTHING SAVES AUTOMATICALLY[/b][/color]
Closing the window discards anything you haven't saved to a file. The suite will offer a backup every 7 minutes while you work. [b]Say yes.[/b][/quote]
[color=#E8B84A]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  ✦  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color]

[size=5][color=#E8B84A][b]❀ Requirements[/b][/color][/size]

[color=#7BD68C][b]To use the tool[/b][/color]
[list]
[*]A modern desktop browser (Chrome or Edge recommended, Firefox works)[/*]
[*]An internet connection when the tools load. Some parts load their libraries online. Your files are never uploaded; everything is processed on your computer.[/*]
[*]For the map renderer: the map and tilesheets unpacked from the game files (for example with xnbcli or StardewXnbHack)[/*]
[/list]
[color=#7BD68C][b]For the mods it makes[/b][/color]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/*]
[*]ValleyTalk [size=2][color=#9AA0C0](only if you use its features)[/color][/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=5][color=#E8B84A][b]❀ Installation[/b][/color][/size]

Download the HTML file and open it in your browser. [b]That's it.[/b]
[color=#E06666][b]Do not[/b][/color] put it in your Mods folder. It's a tool for making mods, not a mod itself.

[color=#E8B84A]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  ✦  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color]

[size=5][color=#E8B84A][b]❀ Known Issues[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#E8B84A][b]Seasonal spritesheets:[/b][/color] conditional loads (such as a winter outfit) don't override the base sheet correctly yet. Use a single spritesheet for now.[/*]
[*][color=#E8B84A][b]Disposition.json:[/b][/color] older mods that store NPC data this way aren't read reliably. Make sure your content.json has an EditData block targeting Data/Characters.[/*]
[*][color=#E8B84A][b]Custom event layouts:[/b][/color] if Debug Commands can't find your events, you can add the event IDs by hand.[/*]
[/list][size=2][color=#9AA0C0]The in-tool Rules and Bug Sheet pages (Guide → Reference) cover these and many more common pitfalls.[/color][/size]

[size=5][color=#E8B84A][b]❀ Coming Soon[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#7BD68C][b]Map Maker[/b][/color]: built, locked until it's fully tested[/*]
[*]Seasonal spritesheet support[/*]
[*]Mail builder for letters, attached items and quest flags[/*]
[*]A warning panel that checks across all your files at once[/*]
[*]Portraiture integration for high-resolution portraits[/*]
[*]Custom objects and items[/*]
[/list]
[color=#E8B84A]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  ✦  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color]
